# Support

WordPress DevKit is a free project kept by one volunteer. This page tells you where to go for each kind of help.

## Read the guides first

The [guides](https://ehsanenaloo.github.io/wordpress-devkit/) cover installation, your first review, the doctor, evidence reports and every specialist skill. Start with:

- [Quick start](https://ehsanenaloo.github.io/wordpress-devkit/guides/quick-start.html)
- [Installation, removal and recovery](https://ehsanenaloo.github.io/wordpress-devkit/guides/installation.html)
- [FAQ](https://ehsanenaloo.github.io/wordpress-devkit/guides/faq.html)

## Ask a question

Open an issue with the [question form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/wordpress-devkit/issues/new?template=question.yml). Say what you want to do and what you tried. Please search [existing issues](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/wordpress-devkit/issues?q=is%3Aissue) first.

## Report a bug

Use the [bug report form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/wordpress-devkit/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml). Include the DevKit version, agent client and the steps to repeat the problem.

## Report a wrong or unsafe skill answer

Use the [skill quality form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/wordpress-devkit/issues/new?template=skill_quality.yml). A minimal reproduction lets the maintainer add a regression case.

## Request a feature

Use the [feature request form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/wordpress-devkit/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml). Describe the problem first.

## Report a security problem

Do not open a public issue. Use GitHub's [private vulnerability report](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/wordpress-devkit/security/advisories/new) and read [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## What to expect

- Help is given by a volunteer in spare time. Replies are best effort, and there is no guaranteed response time.
- There is no phone, email or chat support.
- Only the latest release is supported. Please update before you report a bug.
- Please be kind. The [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) applies in every issue and pull request.
